name: Durable Refund Evidence
goal: Record manual full Paystack Dashboard refund evidence, revoke issued tickets before financial finalization, and resolve held inventory without reclaiming consumed capacity.
dependencies: P0-D Revocation Completeness and Purchase Ceiling
VS-15A Core Revocation and Scanner Visibility
VS-15B Admin Refund and Revocation Operations

provider_evidence.provider_reference: required non-empty refund RRN or reference
provider_evidence.password: existing admin password verified by the current authentication boundary

financial_finalization.precondition: revocation_complete and authoritative issued TicketIssue count is zero

inventory_resolution.held: release exact unexpired hold and authoritative quantity with refund:release:<refund_id>; resolution released_unconsumed
inventory_resolution.consumed: no Redis mutation or counter adjustment; resolution retained_consumed

reconciliation.available_only_when: Refund state completed and resolution released_unconsumed
reconciliation.ambiguous_behavior: manual_review_required true and no upward availability repair

consumed_capacity.reason: Browser admission, asynchronous mobile database persistence, and Android local-first queue/overlay do not provide one global unused-ticket proof.
consumed_capacity.future_blocker: FastCheckin-52n8 unified admission/usage authority and fencing

out_of_scope: Paystack refund API or refund polling
